summary: Retest after serialization fix: all 4 POST create endpoints (groups, raw-items, finished-items, bottling) return 200 with 'id' and no ObjectId leak. Bottling business logic validated end-to-end: tenuta_barbon decrements raw stock, cliente marks materials not_deducted and preserves raw stock, finished item incremented by bottle_count in both cases, new_lot_name creates a lot with correct quantity. PDF endpoint returns application/pdf starting with %PDF. Movements log includes extra.bottling_id. Dashboard summary reflects updated totals. 9/9 pytest tests pass.

minor.issue: allow_credentials=False but login sets httpOnly cookies with SameSite=none — browser clients relying on cookies cross-origin will not have credentials delivered. Bearer-token fallback currently used by frontend, so works, but inconsistent.

critical_code_review_comments: serialize() helper exists but create endpoints manually pop _id and set id — consider using serialize(doc) consistently for DRY.

CORS: allow_credentials=False combined with cookie-based auth (samesite=none, secure=true) is inconsistent; frontend relies on Bearer header only. Either enable credentials with explicit origins or drop cookie setting.
oid() raises 400 but create_bottling calls oid() on user-provided raw_item_id inside a loop; a single bad id aborts the whole bottling instead of being skipped. Consider try/except per material.
No transactional guarantee: if finished-item $inc succeeds but raw $inc fails, state is inconsistent. Acceptable for MVP but should be documented.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_raw_grp, TEST_fin_grp groups, TEST_bottle_075 raw item, TEST_lot_A + TEST_new_lot_Z finished items, and 3 bottling records (not cleaned up — low volume, prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Serialization bug fully fixed. Reusable regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bottling_flow.py covers all POST endpoints + bottling supplier branches + PDF + movements + dashboard. Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration: create_group/raw/finished/bottling spread the inserted doc back into the response dict which still held BSON ObjectId under _id, causing FastAPI JSON encoding to fail. Fix applied: doc.pop('_id', None); doc['id']=str(r.inserted_id) before return. Verified by asserting '_id' absent and 'id' present on all four endpoints.
